m: द्वैधी—भाव m. duality, double nature, MBh.
dilemma, doubt, uncertainty, ib.

separation (esp. of an army, one of the six kinds of royal policy), Mn. vii, 160

a: द्वैधीभावः — 1 Duality, double state or nature. --2 Separation into two, difference, diversity. --3 Doubt, uncertainty, vacillation, suspense; धृतद्वैधीभावकातरं मे मनः Ś. 1. --4 A dilemma. --5 One of the six Guṇas or modes of foreign policy. (According to some authorities it means ‘double-dealing’ or ‘duplicity’, ‘keeping apparently friendly relations with the enemy’; बलिनोर्द्विषतोर्मध्ये वाचात्मानं समर्पयन् . द्वैधीभावेन तिष्ठेत्तु काकाक्षिवदलक्षितः ... According to others it means ‘dividing one's army and encountering a superior enemy in detachments’, ‘harassing the enemy by attacking them in small bands’; द्वैधीभावः स्वबलस्य द्विधाकरणं Mit. on Y. 1. 347; cf. also Ms. 7. 173 and 160). --6 A contest, dispute. --7 Falsehood, duplicity.

a: द्वैपक्षं — Two parties.

m: द्वै—पराक m. (fr. द्वि-प्˚) N. of a Tri-rātra, ŚāṅkhŚr.

s: dvEpyaM

tri, (dvIpe Bavam dvIpasya idam vA । dvIpa + “dvIpAdanusamudraM yaY .” 4 । 3 । 10 । iti yaY .) dvIpasambanDi । dvIpaSabdAt idamarTe zRyapratyayena sADyam । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, mADe । 3 । 76 । “vikrIya diSyAni DanAnyurURi dvEpyAnasAvuttamalABaBAjaH । tarIzu tatratyamaPalguBARqaM sAMyAtrikAnAvapato'Byanandat ॥”)
m: द्वैप्य mf(आ)n. (Pāṇ. iv, 3, 10; 1, 16, Pat.) of or belonging to an island, islander, Śiś. iii, 76.
a: द्वैप्य — a. (प्या, प्यी f.) Living on or relating to an island; Śi. 3. 76.

m: द्वैप्य—भैमायन m. pl. N. of a tribe belonging to the Andhaka-Vṛṣṇis, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 34, Sch.

v: na॰ dvO rASI yasya tasya BAvaH zyaY । dviviDarASiyuktatve ।

m: द्वै—राज्य n. a dominion divided between 2 princes, Mālav. v, 12/13; Rājat.
the boundaries of 2 states, a frontier, Naiṣ. viii, 59.
a: द्वैराज्यं — A dominion divided between two kings.

v: tri॰ dvayo rAtryorBavaH “dvigorvA rAtryahaHsaMvatsarAcca” pakze WaY । dvayorAtryorBave । atrApi samAsAntaviDeranityatvAt na samAsAntaH sUtre rAtrIti QirdeSAt pakze Ka dvirAtrIRa tatrArTe tri॰ ।
m: द्वै—रात्रिक mf(ई)n. of or belonging to a period of 2 nights, Pāṇ. v, 1, 87, Kāś.
द्वै—रूप्य n. duplicity of form, double appearance or nature, BhP.

v: na॰ dvO raTO yatra yudDe svArTe aR । dvAByAmeva raTAmyAmupalakzite yudDe । “dvEraTenAstu vE SAntistava ca mama bA nfpa!” BA॰ va॰ 78 a॰ । “cikIrzan dvEraTaM yudDamaByayAnmaDusUdanam” harivaM॰ 118 a॰ ।
m: द्वै—रथ n. (युद्ध) ‘chariot-duel’, a single combat in chariots, any s˚ c˚, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
द्वै—रथ mf(ई)n. relating to any s˚ c˚ in chariots, ch. of R.
द्वै—रथ m. an adversary, MBh.; BhP.
a: द्वैरथं — 1 A single combat in chariots. --2 A single combat in general. --थः An adversary.

m: द्वै—संध्य n. morning and evening twilight, Kāv.

v: tri॰ dvayoH samayorvarzayorBavaH samAyAH yat “dvigozWaMSca” pA॰ pakze WaY । varzadvayaBave ।
m: द्वै—समिक mf(ई)n. 2 years old, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 15, Vārtt. 2, Pat.
a: द्वैसमिक — a. (की f.) Two years old.

v: na॰ dvEtaYcAdvEtaYca । jIveSvarayorBedABedayoH । “advEtaYca taTA'dvEtaM dvEtAdvEtaM taTEva ca । na dvEtaM nApi cAdvEtamityetat pAramArTikam । na hi nEvAnyasambanGo brahmaBAvena BAvitaH । IdfkzAyAmavasTAyAmavApyaM paramaM padam । dvEtapakzAH samAKyAtA ye'dvEte tu vyavasTitAH” ।

m: द्वैताद्वैतमार्ग m. the path of dualism and non-dualism
द्वैताद्वैतमार्ग—परिभ्रष्ट mfn. having missed it, Prab. ii, 5/6.

s: dvEtIyIkaH
tri, (dvitIya + tIyAdIkak । svArTe vA Ikak .) dbitIyaH । yaTA, -- “dbEtIyIkatayA mito'yamagamattasya prabanDe mahAkAvye cAruRi nEzaDIyacarite sargo nisargojjvalaH ॥” iti nEzaDam । 2 । 110 ॥
v: tri॰ dvitIya + svArTe Ikak । dvitIye “dvEtIyIkatayA mito'yamagamat tasya prabanDe mahA” ityAdi nEza॰ ।
m: द्वै˚तीयीक mf(ई)n. the second (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 2, 7, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
a: द्वैतीयीक — a. (की f.) Second; द्वैतीयीकतया मितोऽयमगमत्तस्य प्रबंधे महाकाव्ये चारुणि नैषधीयचरिते सर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः N. 2. 110; cf. तार्तीयीक.

m: द्वै˚तीयीक—ता f., Naiṣ. ii, 110.
द्वैतीयक mf(ई)n. recurring every second day (fever; cf. द्वितीयक), L.

s: dvEtaM

klI, (dbiDA itaM dvItam । tasya BAvaH । yuvAdittvAt aR । svArTe aR vA .) dvayam । iti hemacandraH । 6 । 60 ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 1 । 15 । 30 । “viSoko brahmasampattyA saMCinnadbEtasaMSayaH । lInaprakftinErguRyAdaliNgatvAdasamBavaH ॥”) lokAdirUpam । ekAyano'sAvitiSlokavyAKyAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥ (vanaviSezaH ॥ gatadvike, tri । yaTA, kirAte । 1 । 1 । “savarRiliNgI viditaH samAyayO yuDizWiraM dvEtavane vanecaraH ॥” “dvEtavane dvEtAKye tapovane । yadvA, dve ite gate yasmAt tat dvItam । dvItava dvEtaM tacca tadvanaYceti tasmin । SokamohAdirahite ityarTaH ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM mallinATaH ॥)
v: na॰ dviDA itaM dvItaM tasya BAvaH svArTe vA aR । dvEDIBAve 2 dvaye yugale ca । dvEtAdvetayoruBayorapi sapramARakatvAt nyAyAdimate dvEtam vedAntimate advEtaM rAmAnujamate viSizwAdvEtamityeva sTitam । anye SudDAdvEtamicCanti । tatrAcAryyA evamAhuH । “advEtameva satyaM tasmin dvEtaM na satyamaDyastam । rajatamiva SuktikAyAM mfgatfzRAyAmivodakasPuraRam । AropitaM yadi syAdadvEtaM vastvavastuni dvEte । yuktaM nEva tadA syAt satye'DyAso BavatyasatyAnAm । yadyAropaRamuBayostadvyatiriktasya kasyacidBAvaH । AropaRaM na SUnye tasmAddvEtasatyatA grAhyA । pratyakzAdyanavagataM SrutyA pratipAdanIyamadvEtam । dvEtaM na pratipAdyaM tasya svayameva lokasidDatvAditi । prapaYco yadi vidyeta nivartteta na saSayaH । mAyAmAtramidaM dvEtamadvEtaM paramArTataH .”
m: द्वै—त See द्वैत.
द्वैत n. (fr. 1. द्वि-ता) duality, duplicity, dualism (cf. -वाद), doubt, ŚBr.; Kap.; Prab.; BhP. &c.
a: द्वैतं — [द्विधा इतं द्वीतं तस्य भावः स्वार्थे अण्] 1 Duality. --2 Dualism in philosophy, the assertion of two distinct principles, such as the maintenance of the doctrine that spirit and matter, Brahman and the universe, or the Individual and the Supreme Soul, are different from each other; cf. अद्वैत; किं शास्त्रं श्रवणेन यस्य गलति द्वैतांधकारोत्करः Bv. 1. 86. --3 N. of a forest. --Comp. --वनं N. of a forest; Ki. 1. 1. --वादः the doctrine of dualism; see above. --वादिन् m. a philosopher who maintains the dvaita doctrine.

m: द्वैत—भृत m. pl. N. of a philos. school, Cat.
द्वैत—निर्णय m. (-टीका f. and -फक्किका f., -शिवपूजा-संग्रह m. and -सिद्धान्त-संग्रह, m.) N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—निर्णय—फक्किका f. N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—निर्णय—शिवपूजा-संग्रह m. N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—निर्णय—सिद्धान्त-संग्रह m. N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—निर्णय—टीका f. N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—परिशिष्ट and द्वैत—भूषण, n. N. of philos. wk.
द्वैत—सिद्धान्त-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
द्वैत—सिद्धि f. N. of wk.

s: dvEtavAdI

[n] tri, (dvEtaM jIva ISvaraSceti dvayaM vadatIti । vada + RiniH .) jIveSvarayorBedavAdI । ISvarAtiriktajIvavaktA । tasya mataM yaTA, paramAtmano jIvAtmA pfTak tanmaDye kezAYcinmate prakftiratiriktA kezAYcinmate prakftiradfzwamAtre paryyavasitA evaM jIvaSca pfTak । atra pramARam । janmakarmmamaraRAnAM pratiniyamAdayugapatpravftteSca । puruzabahutvaM sidDaM trEguRyaviparyyayAccEva ॥ iti sANKyamatam ॥ tatreSvaraH sarvvajYaH paramAtmA eka eva । jIvaH pratiSarIraM BinnaH viBurnityaSca । iti gotamamatam ॥ iha brahmaRo jIvetaratvapratipAdanAt tayoradvEtaM nABimatam । netaro'nupapatterBedavyapadeSAcca mukto'pyasfpya vyapadeSAdAkASo'rTAntaratvAdivyapadeSAdBogamAtrasAmyaliNgAcceti sUtrErmokze'pi tayordvEtanirUpaRAcca । iti govindaBAzyamatam ॥ yato dvEtamate yuktireva pramARaM yuktyA yat Palati tadeva sarvvADyAtmavidyApratipAdakaSrutInAM tAtparyyam । iti rAmAnujamataYca ॥

v: pu॰ dvEtamaDikftya vAdaH । gOtamAdipraRIte jIveSvaraviBedanirRAyake 1 kaTArUpagranTaBede kapilAdipraRIte nAnAjIvanirRAyake 2 kaTABede ca । tatra sAMKyamate yaTA jIvAnAM parasparaBedastaTA sAM॰ kA॰ tattvakO॰ ukto yaTA “janmamaraRakaraRAnAM pratiniyamAdayugapatpravftteSca । puruzabahutvaM sidDaM trEguRyaviparyayAccEva” sAM॰ kA॰ । “puruzabahutvaM sidDaM kasmAjjanmamaraRakaraRAnAM pratiniyamAt nikAyaviSizwABirapUrvABirdehendriyamano'haNkArabudDivedanABiH puruzasyABisambanDojanma na tu puruzasya pariRAmastasyApariRAmitvAt tezAmeva ca dehAdInAmupAttAnAM parityAgo maraRaM na tvAtmanovinASaH tasya kUwasTanityatvAt । karaRAni budDyAdIni trayodaSa tezAM janmamaraRakaraRAnAM pratiniyamovyavasTA sA KalviyaM sarvaSarIrezvekasmin puruze nopapadyate tadA Kalvekasmin jAyamAne sarve jAyeran mriyamARe ca mriyeran anDAdO cEkasmin sarve evAnDAdayaH vicitte cEkasmin sarva eva vicittAH syurityavyavasTA syAt pratikzetraM puruzaBede tu Bavati vyavasTA । nacEkasyApri puruzasya dehopADAnaBedAdvyavasTeti yuktaM pARistanAdyupADiBedenApi janmamaraRAdivyavasTAprasaNgAt । na hi pARO vfkRe, jAte vA stanAdO mahatyavayave, yuvatirjAtA mftA vA BavatIti । itaSca pratikzetraM puruzaBeda ityAha ayugapatpravftteSca pravfttiH prayatnalakzaRAyadyapyantaHkaraRavarttinI taTApi puruze upacaryate taTA ca tastinnekatra SarIre prayatamAne sa eva sarvaSarIrezveka iti sarvatra prayateta sarvARyeva SarIrARi yugapaccAlayet nAnAtve tu nAyaM doza iti । itaSca puruzaBeda ityAha trEguRyabiparyayAccEva evakAroBinnakramaH sidDamityasyAnantaraM drazwavyaH sidDameva nAsidDam । trayoguRAstrEguRyaM tasya viparyayo'nyaTABAvaH, kecit Kalu satvanikAyAH satvabahulA yaTordDvasrotasaH kecidrajobahulAH yaTA manuzyAH । kecittamobahulAH yaTA tiryyagyonayaH । so'yamIdfSastrEguRyaviparyayo'nyaTABAvastezu satvanikAyezu na Bavet yadyekaH puruzaH syAdBede tvayama doza iti” tattvakO॰ । “janmAdivyavasTAtaH puruzabahutvam” nAdvEta SrutiviroDeH jAtiparatvAt” sAM॰ sU॰ ।
m: द्वैत—वाद m. dualism, Cat.

v: tri॰ dvEtaM jIvaBedaM jIveSvarayorBedaM vA vadati vada--Rini । jIvaBedavAdini jIveSvarayorBedavAdini ca nEyAyikAdO ।
m: द्वैत—वादिन् m. ‘dualist’, assertor of dualism (a philosopher who asserts the 2 principles or the existence of the human soul as separate from the Supreme Being), L. (cf. अ-द्व्˚).
द्वैत—वैतथ्योपनिषद् f. N. of an Upan.

v: na॰ dve SokamohAdike ite yasmAt dvItaM svArTe aR karmma॰ । 1 tapovanaBede “yuDizWiraM dvEtavane vanecaraH” kirA॰ । 2 tAdfSavanopalakzite sarovaraBede ca । “idaM dvEtavanaM nAma saraH puRyajalozitam .” “gacCAmaH puRyaM viKyAtaM mahaddvEtavanaM saraH” BA॰ va॰ 24 a॰ । “tena hEtena DvasA dvEtavana Ije mAtsyo rAjA yatrEtatdvEtavanaM sarastadetadgATayABigItaM caturdaSa dvEtavane rAjA saMgrAmajidDayAn indrAya vftraGne'baDnAt tasmAdddEtavanaM saraH” Sata॰ brA॰ 13 । 5 । 4 । 9 ।
m: द्वैतवन m. (fr. द्वित-वन) patr. of the king Dhvasan, ŚBr.
द्वैतवन (द्वैत्˚), mfn. belonging or relating to Dhvasan Dvaitavana, ŚBr.; MBh.
द्वैतवन n. (with or sc. वन) N. of a forest, MBh. iii, 453 &c.; Kir. i, 1.
द्वैत—विवेक m. N. of wk.

v: tri॰ dvEtaM BedaH sammatatayA'styasya ini । dvEtavAdini nEyAyikAdO । “svasidDAntavyavasTAsu dvEtino niScitA dfQam । parasparaM viruDyante tEriyaM na viruDyate” । “advEtaM paramArTo hi dvEtaM tadBeda ucyate । tezAmuBayaTAdvEtaM tenAyaM na viruDyate” ।
m: द्वैतिन् m. = द्वैत-वादिन्, Śaṃk.
a: द्वैतिन् — m. A philosopher who maintains the dvaita doctrine.
द्वैवार्षिक — a. (की f.) Biennial.

m: द्वै—वचन mf(ई)n. relating to the dual, ĀśvŚr.
द्वै—वर्षिक mf(ई)n. biennial, happening after 2 years, W. (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 16).

v: na॰ dviviDasya BAvaH zyaY । prakAradvaye “dvEviDyaM tu BavedvyApteranvayavyatirekataH” BAzA॰ ।
m: द्वै—विध्य n. twofold state or nature or character, duplicity, variance, MBh.; Suśr. &c.
a: {{दैविध्यं->द्वैविध्यं||20170131||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्335|}} — 1 Duality, twofold nature. --2 Variance, diversity, difference.

m: द्वैयाहावक mf(ई)n. fr. द्व्य्-आहाव, L.

v: tri॰ dvayorAhAvayornipAnayorBavaH DUmA॰ vuY Ec । dvayorAhAvayorBave ।

tri॰ dvyaharUpaH kAlo yasya tasya BAvaH zyaY । padAntAByAM yvAByAM pUrvamEc । dvyahakAlajAtasya BAve । “dvEyahakAlye tu yaTAnyAyam” jE॰ sU॰ “dvEyahakAlye kriyamARe yaTAnyAyaM kftaM Bavati tasmAt dvEyahakAlyaM syAt । codakaH taTA anugfhIto Bavati pakftO hi SrUyate । “pUrvedyuH agniM gfhRAti uttaramahardevatAM yajet” iti । tasmAt dvyahakAlam ekamaBinirvartya tadaharevopakramyA'paredyuH parisamAvayet BA॰ “vacanAddvEkakAlyaM syAt” sU॰ “nEtadevaM dvyahakAlA vikftayo BaveyuH iti sadyaskAlAH syuH” SavaraBA॰ ।
m: द्वैयहकाल्य n. abstr. fr. द्व्यह-काल, Jaim.

v: tri॰ dvayorahnorBavaH “dvigorvA rAtryahaHsaMvatsarAcca” pA॰ pakze WaY samAsAntaviDeranityatvAt na wac sUtre rAtryahariti nAnvatayA nirdeSAt si॰ kO॰ । ahnAdeSaH । dvayorahnorBave ।
m: द्वैयह्निक mf(ई)n. (fr. द्व्यहन्) of or belonging to 2 days, Pāṇ. v, 1, 87, Kāś.
द्वै—योग्य n. (fr. द्वि-योग) a combination or connection with two, Pāṇ. v, 1, 30, Vārtt. 1.

m: द्वैषणीया f. a sort of betel pepper, L. (cf. द्नेषणीय, द्वेष्य).
